split_ownership_measurement.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
p='config/GEDE01/splits.txt'
lines=open(p).read().splitlines()
i=lines.index('game/game_fn_801B3CC8.c:')
total=0
exception_total=0
count=0
for line in lines[i+1:i+4]:
 m=re.match(r'\s*(\S+)\s+start:0x([0-9A-Fa-f]+) end:0x([0-9A-Fa-f]+)',line)
 name,a,b=m.group(1),int(m.group(2),16),int(m.group(3),16)
 size=b-a; total+=size; count+=1
 if name in ('extab','extabindex'): exception_total+=size
 print(f'section={name} start=0x{a:08X} end=0x{b:08X} owned_bytes={size}')
print(f'owned_sections={count} total_owned_bytes={total} exception_metadata_bytes={exception_total}')
PY
